role: The logic material (circuits, pressure plates, tripwires, levers, torches, rails): not solid, does not block light, does not block movement, no tool required.

members.name: MaterialLogic
members.note: the circuits rows: isSolid false, opaque false, blocksMovement false, no tool required

notes: The torches, levers and rails that use this material appear in every played session, so the rows are exercised indirectly even though no recording or test names MaterialLogic.
